Create one production sprite-animation sheet for Bullets of Fury. Reference 1 is the CURRENT ACTUAL in-game pilot's JET, seen from overhead only as an identity guide. Generate its proper forward-aligned cinematic perspective views. This must be the same exact recognizable jet, preserving wings, engine count, cockpit, armor proportions and pilot-specific palette. This is NOT the large Fury mothership/spaceship.
ONE sheet, EXACTLY 32 isolated frames, exactly EIGHT columns and FOUR rows, row-major. First TWO rows (frames 1-16) are a smooth FRONT-ON flight cycle: looking straight down the aircraft longitudinal centerline at its nose and canopy as it emerges toward the viewer. Last TWO rows (frames 17-32) are a smooth REAR FOLLOW-CAMERA flight cycle: symmetrical rear engines in foreground, long fuselage and nose point straight away into the screen. Level wings; camera is exactly on axis; zero roll, zero bank, zero yaw, no diagonal or three-quarter shots. Keep the aircraft root and hull scale constant throughout each 16-frame view. Only subtle exhaust flutter, reflected lighting, intake/aileron micro-articulation and engine pulsation animate; do not move the whole jet within its cell. The engine will move and scale the whole jet toward Earth. Every frame is a genuinely drawn in-between, not a still repeated.
Art: extremely polished HD Neo-Geo arcade pixel art matching the supplied shipped sprite, crisp clustered metal shading and rivets, readable silhouette, no painted blur or vector shapes. All full wing tips, full fins, complete hull and complete flame tips must remain within every cell. Jet including exhaust occupies at most 68 percent of each cell width and height, centered on the same cockpit/engine mount, with large clear gutters on all four sides. Genuine transparent background, no black rectangle, no stars, scenery, portal, text, labels, numbering, borders or ground shadow. Exactly 8 by 4 poses, all 32 present.
Pilot identity: COLE. Exact visible details: olive armor, vivid green center spine, long glazed green cockpit, two rounded silver engine nacelles, broad swept wings, exactly TWO lime-green exhausts.
